description: Every prediction in arifOS must carry explicit horizon and confidence. System has the right to say 'signal ends here.'

signal_classes.SIGNAL: confidence > 0.7 AND horizon is within reasonable bounds
signal_classes.FICTION_BOUNDARY: horizon = exceeded OR confidence > 0.7 but horizon > 90d

accountability_rules: Predictions with horizon > 30d must be re-evaluated monthly
Predictions with confidence > 0.8 and horizon > 90d are suspicious — flag for review
Any prediction past its horizon is automatically demoted to 'historical attempt'
System must never present exceeded-horizon predictions as current guidance
